summary: Per-frame decay of a track-opening progress timer. The function is skipped when the session/phase dword at this+0x3FC4 equals 2 or 1, or when the timer float at this+0x2C is negative. When the timer equals 5.0 a one-time utility call UtilityFunction_e570(this, (float)dbl_8AFEA0) fires. A dev-only debug log writes the string aApplyingFrameT via DebugLogWrite when dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_1, 4958) is true. The decrement delta dbl_8AFE90 is clamped into [0.0099999998, 0.5], then subtracted from the timer at this+0x2C. When the timer reaches zero or below, the byte flag at this+0x29 is set to 1 and -1082130432 is written into the timer field.

operations.description: Skip the whole update when the dword at this+0x3FC4 is 2 or 1, or when the timer float at this+0x2C is negative.
When the timer float at this+0x2C equals 5.0, call UtilityFunction_e570(this, v4) passing dbl_8AFEA0 (global 0x008AFEA0) cast to float as the second argument.
Dev/debug logging: if dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_1, 4958) is true, write the string aApplyingFrameT through DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aApplyingFrameT).
Clamp the decrement delta v5 (initialized from dbl_8AFE90, global 0x008AFE90) into [0.0099999998, 0.5].
Subtract the clamped delta from the opening-progress timer: timer (this+0x2C float) becomes timer - v5.
On timer expiry (new value <= 0.0): set the byte flag at this+0x29 to 1 and write -1082130432 into this+0x2C.
